name: Agent Circuit Breaker

directory_listings.name: FAUN.toolbox
directory_listings.description: Developer-tool directory listing with a dedicated profile and scorecard.

summary: Explicit permissions before AI agent execution, with typed local tools, durable MCP workflows, exact single-use approvals, and a runnable offline demo.

capabilities.name: Action evaluation
capabilities.scope: Known patterns in proposed shell commands, filesystem operations, and SQL. Unclassified actions remain UNKNOWN.

capabilities.name: Trajectory evaluation
capabilities.scope: Configured run contracts, actor/delegation constraints, supported secret-read-to-egress patterns, blocked retries, and output boundaries.

capabilities.name: Principal and capability checks
capabilities.scope: Trusted integration supplies private tokens and bound identity. Capabilities scope actions and target resources when configured.

capabilities.name: Exact approvals
capabilities.scope: Action and policy fingerprints, expiry, one-time consumption before execution.

capabilities.name: Durable local runtime
capabilities.scope: SQLite state shared by trusted workers on one host; suspension, revocation, unresolved-start detection, explicit reconciliation.

capabilities.name: Audit evidence
capabilities.scope: Hash chains, optional HMAC signatures, and checkpoints retained outside the mutable log/database boundary for rollback detection.

capabilities.name: Typed workflow execution
capabilities.scope: Pinned reads, repository status, fixed reports, copies, Base64 encoding, and owner-approved publication through six scoped tools.

capabilities.name: Authenticated artifact provenance
capabilities.scope: Source sensitivity follows supported transformations and exact artifact versions; arbitrary programs and model summaries are not tracked.

capabilities.name: Durable stdio MCP
capabilities.scope: Modern discovery and legacy initialization, durable run reuse, bounded requests, cancellation, and one server per state directory.

capabilities.name: Catalog quarantine
capabilities.scope: New, missing, changed, or malformed definitions require explicit owner review. Catalog fingerprints do not attest implementation.

entry_points.name: Workflow.call
entry_points.requirement: Protected owner policy/state and POSIX file workflows; exact artifact and destination authorization.

entry_points.name: workflow-mcp
entry_points.requirement: Same typed dispatcher and RuntimeGate lifecycle; native host tools and other servers remain outside scope.

entry_points.name: Responses Dispatcher
entry_points.requirement: Real offline executor tested. Live API use unverified; hosted tools excluded. Replayed call IDs do not reexecute.

entry_points.name: Claude Code / Cursor hooks
entry_points.requirement: Separate documented payload/config fixtures tested. Native applications unverified; host must honor the decision.

entry_points.name: Codex MCP configuration
entry_points.requirement: CLI overrides and MCP SDK tested; project discovery and native invocation unverified.

entry_points.name: CLI / Python evaluation API
entry_points.requirement: Caller must execute only on ALLOW.

entry_points.name: Legacy MCP proxy
entry_points.requirement: No RuntimeGate execution lifecycle. HTTP mode is a custom JSON POST bridge, not full Streamable HTTP.

limitations: Not an OS sandbox or arbitrary-agent containment system.
Direct executor, subprocess, or tool calls that bypass the integration are outside scope.
Single-host SQLite coordination is not distributed coordination.
Replay prevention does not guarantee exactly-once external side effects after process death.
Local audit chains and HMAC signatures are not immutable storage.
Readiness checks inspect local store/audit posture and cannot prove application-wide mediation.
Principal labels alone are not authentication. Trusted tokens must remain outside model-visible and attacker-writable state.
Policy, executor code, state/provenance, keys, and approval controls must be inaccessible to the agent.
Artifact provenance covers supported typed transformations, not arbitrary shell/Python programs or model-generated content.

evidence.browser_behavior: Replays recorded results. No command execution or Python evaluation occurs in the browser.
evidence.runtime_scenario: Synthetic safe validator: pending request not executed, exact approval executed, approval replay refused. Custom safe-write evaluator and constrained test-file executor.

published_validation.scope: Separately authored review within the implementation session, not certification; local macOS Python 3.14.8 measurements.
